purpose: The service delivers events of the platform to the callback endpoints of merchants.

components.name: Webhook Dispatcher
components.evidence: The Webhook Dispatcher delivers events of the platform to the callback endpoints of the merchants.

components.name: Delivery queue
components.evidence: The dispatcher takes events from the delivery queue and sends them to the callback URL in order per subscription.

components.name: Internal load balancer
components.evidence: The dispatcher runs as two instances behind the internal load balancer and is deployed by the platform team in rolling steps.
